_README: INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN — read before relying on this file.
This contains ONLY the fixed-date NSE holidays, which fall on the same
calendar date every year and can be stated without a source.
It deliberately OMITS every lunar/luni-solar holiday: Holi, Mahashivratri,
Id-ul-Fitr, Bakri Id, Muharram, Ganesh Chaturthi, Dussehra, Diwali,
Laxmi Puja / Muhurat, Guru Nanak Jayanti, and Good Friday. Those dates
move every year and are set by NSE circular. Writing plausible-looking
dates here would produce a calendar that is confidently wrong — the
engine would trade on a closed day or skip an open one, and nothing in
the data would reveal it.
CONSEQUENCE: a year populated only from this file will hold ~5 rows, not
the 12-18 a real NSE year has. The calendar_health alert for '<10
holidays loaded' is EXPECTED to fire until the Upstox API has run once.
That alert is doing its job.
TO COMPLETE: run POST /jobs/holidays once. Upstox returns the full
current-year list including the moving dates and the Muhurat session,
and those rows overwrite these by trade_date. For 2023-2025 backfill,
paste the dates from the NSE holiday circular into the years below.
Muhurat is intentionally absent: its date moves and its session window
comes from /v2/market/timings. It must never be hardcoded.
